usedFor: Slide holds messages, orders and contacts, and Documint fills a document template through “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new order is created” in Slide, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: An order is when a document is needed, and the action pours its details into your template.

watchOut: A busy trigger like “When a contact is updated” runs “Add Content To Template” often, making many documents.
